title: Taskflow Agent finds authorization bypass in graphql-ruby
summary: In the Execution::Next runner, a resolver that raises GraphQL::UnauthorizedError from its authorization hook is treated as authorized, so the resolver still runs and can disclose data or perform side effects.
ai_role: GHSL credits its Taskflow Agent with discovery and says GHSL team members manually verified the issue. The report identifies the Execution::Next code path and affected versions; no separate CVE is listed.
classification_note: The GHSL advisory documents the authorization bypass and fix; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL’s timeline says the issue was fixed 2026-07-17 and graphql-ruby v2.6.6 released 2026-07-21; patch state in dependent applications is not checked.

impacts.conditions: Execution::Next schemas following the documented authorized? UnauthorizedError pattern; resolver runs despite authorization failure.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
